name: TC-SR-004 — 买手弃用单图/整组与撤销 [P0]
description: 验证弃用弹窗(4原因)、弃用整组、撤销弃用、状态点提示
page: 迭代详情-试拍与评审 tab

steps.expression: (() => { const discardBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, [class*=discard], [class*=action]')).filter(b => b.textContent.includes('弃用')); const discardGroup = discardBtns.find(b => b.textContent.includes('本组')); return { discardBtnCount: discardBtns.length, discardGroup: !!discardGroup }; })()

(() => { const discardBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, [class*=action]')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('弃用') && !b.textContent.includes('本组')); if (discardBtn) { discardBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, [class*=modal]'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const reasons = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper, [class*=option]')).map(r => r.textContent.trim()); const expectedReasons = ['穿搭穿法', '模特长相', 'AI 感强', '其他']; const matched = expectedReasons.filter(e => reasons.some(r => r.includes(e))); return { found: true, reasons, matched, allMatched: matched.length === expectedReasons.length }; })()
steps.description: 验证弃用原因弹窗4选项

_testDesign.preconditions: IN_REVIEW状态，当前用户是买手，审核视图中
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 点击弃用单图
2. 验证弃用原因弹窗4选项
3. 选择原因后确认弃用
4. 验证图片标记为弃用
5. 点击撤销弃用
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 弃用原因弹窗展示4选项：穿搭穿法、模特长相、AI感强、其他
2. 确认后图片标记为弃用状态
3. 图组导航状态点提示
4. 可撤销单图弃用
5. 可弃用本组/撤销本组弃用
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/试拍与评审
